QUOTE: "Saves that pending state, then calls `client.createPost` once more." and "On failure, either removes the post (for the same three errors) or sets `props.failed` again so the user can retry."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states one new attempt via `retryFailedPost`, and on failure it either removes the post for the same three errors or marks it failed again. It also says "Each retry is a single manual attempt" and that `createPost` has no loop and disables retries.
